text: Nope, not doing that. Like I said, I want the same tablet. If you can't do that, I want to return it. Can you do that? And also cancel the charger I bought, because it goes with the tablet. And return the sneaker too.
zh: 不，不这么做。就像我说的，我想要同一个平板电脑。如果你做不到这一点，我想退货。你能做到吗？另外，取消我买的充电器，因为它和平板电脑一起的。还有，退回那双运动鞋。
